mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate in equity valuation models, compressing discount rates and increasing present values of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns in the lowest FEDFUNDS quartile are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1300) and retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) indicates broad-based demand contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 700000, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day returns in the highest INDPRO quartile are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units signal weak residential construction activity that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low employment growth (PAYEMS < 159000) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicate labor market stagnation that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS < 159000 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) supports corporate earnings expansion and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
